function: TD3 reinforcement learning jointly sets RIS phase shifts, access control coefficient and pilot length to minimize the average peak age of information of uplink grant-free devices (p. 8-9).
system: Uplink cell-free massive MIMO, M APs with N antennas and low-resolution ADCs, R reflecting RISs with L elements each, K single-antenna MTCDs; frequency band not stated (p. 3).
method: TD3 actor-critic reinforcement learning, four-layer feedforward networks, trained by interaction with a simulated environment at the CPU; wrapped in an Agentic AI framework (p. 9-10).
data_channel: Custom simulation: Rayleigh direct paths plus RIS-aided correlated paths, three-slope path loss with shadow fading, uniformly placed APs and MTCDs; no dataset (p. 3, 10).
test_conditions: Online training in the simulator (500 episodes, 75 steps); sweeps over APs, MTCDs, antennas, RIS elements, SINR threshold; no stated test on conditions unseen in training (p. 10-12).
baselines: Learned: DDPG-based approach of [32]. Non-learned: epsilon-greedy heuristic, random RIS phase, fixed phases 0, pi/2 and pi, plus an undefined 'Baseline' curve in Fig. 10 (p. 11-12).
metrics: Average peak age of information (PAoI), average uplink SINR, reward convergence versus training episodes (p. 10-12).
q1_support: p. 3: "denotes the direct Rayleigh fading channel"; p. 10: "The correlation model for the reflecting elements of the RIS is adopted from [46]". Custom Rayleigh simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 12: "the proposed scheme consistently outperforms all baselines under identical conditions". Results are sweeps over APs, MTCDs, antennas, RIS elements and SINR threshold; no model trained in one setting is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 11: "The DDPG-based approach proposed in [32]"; p. 13: "the random phase strategy provides no noticeable PAoI reduction". Learned DDPG and non-learned random and fixed RIS phases, both compared on average PAoI.
q4_support: p. 10: "Each hidden layer contains 256 neurons with Tanh activation". Only the network architecture is given; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime of the TD3 method is reported.
q5_support: p. 10: "K MTCDs and M APs are uniformly distributed". Simulated scenario only; no link to code or data anywhere in the paper, and no public dataset or measured data.
notes: PDF as given (preprint, no arXiv stamp), title 'Agentic AI-Driven Average PAoI Minimization for RIS-Empowered Cell-Free Massive MIMO Systems with Low-Resolution ADCs', not verified against the DOI. Included because TD3 learns RIS phase shifts (p. 8, Eq. 36) jointly with access control, so above_phy does not apply; area 3 by RIS configuration, but the objective is PAoI, not rate; reviewer to confirm. q3 rests on DDPG and random or fixed RIS phases, not on the epsilon-greedy heuristic.
